=====================================================
TRAE AI IDE IMPLEMENTATION PROMPT
ScopeIQ Header & Footer Update
=====================================================

OVERVIEW:
Update the ScopeIQ wizard page to use the standardized header and footer from the IMC Services page for consistent branding across The Hub ecosystem.

=====================================================
STEP 1: LOCATE THE FILE
=====================================================

Open the following file in Trae:
/IMCServices/scopeiq-wizard/index.html

(Or the equivalent path where your ScopeIQ wizard is located)

=====================================================
STEP 2: PASTE THIS PROMPT INTO TRAE
=====================================================

Copy and paste the following prompt into Trae's prompt box:

---BEGIN PROMPT---

I need you to update the ScopeIQ wizard page header and footer to match the IMC Services page branding. Here are the specific changes:

TASK 1: REPLACE THE HEADER
---------------------------
Remove the current header section and replace it with this exact header code:


TASK 2: ADD HEADER CSS STYLES
------------------------------
Add these CSS styles to the <style> section in the <head> (replace any existing header styles):

```css
/* ===========================================
   HEADER - FROM IMC SERVICES
=========================================== */
.hub-header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.hub-header.scrolled {
  background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.98);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}

.header-container {
  max-width: 1400px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 3rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 80px;
}

.header-logo {
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.header-logo:hover {
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.hub-nav-logo-img {
  height: 36px;
  width: auto;
}

.header-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 50px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.nav-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.625rem 1rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  border-radius: 30px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-item:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
}

.nav-item.active {
  background: rgba(249, 111, 110, 0.08);
  color: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(249, 111, 110, 0.15);
}

.nav-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-icon-img {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.nav-item:hover .nav-icon {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.nav-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1;
}

.mobile-menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0.5rem;
}

/* Mobile Header Styles */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .header-container {
    padding: 0 1.5rem;
    height: 70px;
  }

  .hub-nav-logo-img {
    height: 32px;
  }

  .header-nav {
    display: none;
  }

  .header-nav.mobile-active {
    display: flex;
    position: absolute;
    top: 70px;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.98);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 0;
    gap: 0;
  }

    width: 100%;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 1rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }

  .mobile-menu-toggle {
    display: block;
  }
}
```

TASK 4: ADD FOOTER CSS STYLES
------------------------------
Add these CSS styles to the <style> section (replace any existing footer styles):

```css
/* ===========================================
   FOOTER - FROM IMC SERVICES (COMPACT VERSION)
=========================================== */
.hub-footer {
  background: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.6);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 4rem 0 2rem;
  margin-top: 6rem;
}

.footer-container {
  max-width: 1400px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 3rem;
}

.footer-main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 2fr;
  gap: 4rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.footer-brand {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.footer-logo-section {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.footer-dual-logo {
  width: 350px;
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

.footer-tagline {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 100;
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 380px;
}

.footer-links {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 2rem;
}

.footer-link-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 1.25rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.footer-link-card:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-color: var(--lg-coral);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.footer-link-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.footer-link-text {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.footer-bottom {
  padding-top: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.footer-copyright {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.footer-social {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.footer-social a {
  color: var(--text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.footer-social a:hover {
  color: var(--lg-coral);
}

/* Mobile Footer Styles */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .footer-main {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 3rem;
  }

  .footer-links {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .footer-container {
    padding: 0 1.5rem;
  }

  .footer-links {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
}
```

TASK 5: UPDATE JAVASCRIPT
--------------------------
Make sure the header scroll effect and mobile menu toggle are in the JavaScript section at the bottom of the file. Add or update this code:

```javascript
// Header scroll effect
const hubHeader = document.getElementById('hubHeader');
if (hubHeader) {
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (window.pageYOffset > 50) {
      hubHeader.classList.add('scrolled');
    } else {
      hubHeader.classList.remove('scrolled');
    }
  });
}

// Mobile menu toggle
const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobileToggle');
const headerNav = document.getElementById('headerNav');

if (mobileToggle && headerNav) {
  mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    headerNav.classList.toggle('mobile-active');
    mobileToggle.textContent = headerNav.classList.contains('mobile-active') ? '✕' : '☰';
  });
}
```

TASK 6: UPDATE MAIN CONTENT WRAPPER
------------------------------------
Ensure the main wizard content has proper padding to account for the fixed header. Update or add this CSS:

```css
.wizard-content {
  padding-top: 80px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}
```

IMPORTANT NOTES:
----------------
1. Keep all existing wizard functionality intact (questions, progress bar, email capture, results)
2. Do not remove any existing JavaScript for the wizard logic
3. Ensure all wizard screens maintain their current functionality
4. Test the mobile menu toggle after implementation
5. Verify that the active state on "ScopeIQ" nav item is working
6. Check that all image paths are correct for your file structure
7. Make sure the wizard content doesn't overlap with the fixed header

After making these changes, save the file and test:
- Header appears fixed at top
- Navigation links work correctly
- Mobile menu toggles properly
- Footer appears at bottom with all links working
- Wizard functionality remains intact
- Page scrolls smoothly without content jumping

---END PROMPT---

=====================================================
STEP 3: VERIFY THE CHANGES
=====================================================

After Trae implements the changes, verify:

✓ Header is fixed at top with "The Hub" logo
✓ Navigation pill shows 5 items (Home, Services, Advisory, ScopeIQ, StrategyIQ)
✓ ScopeIQ has "active" state (coral background)
✓ Mobile menu works (hamburger icon)
✓ Footer shows dual logo on left
✓ Footer has 6 link cards in grid
✓ All wizard functionality still works
✓ Progress bar displays properly
✓ Email form submits correctly
✓ Results page shows recommendations

=====================================================
STEP 4: TROUBLESHOOTING
=====================================================

If something doesn't work:

ISSUE: Header overlaps content
FIX: Ensure .wizard-content has padding-top: 80px;

ISSUE: Images not loading
FIX: Check image paths - adjust based on your folder structure

ISSUE: Mobile menu doesn't work
FIX: Verify JavaScript for mobile toggle is present

ISSUE: Footer links broken
FIX: Update href paths to match your site structure

ISSUE: Wizard stops working
FIX: Ensure all existing wizard JavaScript was preserved
